# Commands, groups and timers

C# methods for a **Run C# code** step. See [C# methods](index.md) for how to use them.

![A Run C# code step in the action editor](../../assets/screens/actions-csharp-step.png)

## EnableCommand

Turns a command on, by its id or name. Stops your code with an error when no command has that id or name.

```csharp
void EnableCommand(string id)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.EnableCommand("!hug");
```

## DisableCommand

Turns a command off, by its id or name, so chat can no longer use it. Stops your code with an error when no command has that id or name.

```csharp
void DisableCommand(string id)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.DisableCommand("!hug");
```

## GetCommands

Gives you a list of all your commands, each with its id, name, group, whether it is on, its chat words and its cooldowns in seconds.

```csharp
List<CommandData> GetCommands()
```

**Gives back:** A list of your commands.

**Example**

```csharp
var commands = CPH.GetCommands();
CPH.LogInfo($"You have {commands.Count} commands.");
```

## CommandGetCounter

Tells you how many times a command was used in total, by its id or name. Stops your code with an error when no command has that id or name.

```csharp
int CommandGetCounter(string id)
```

**Gives back:** The number of uses.

**Example**

```csharp
int uses = CPH.CommandGetCounter("!hug");
CPH.LogInfo($"!hug was used {uses} times.");
```

## CommandResetCounter

Sets a command's total use counter back to 0. Stops your code with an error when no command has that id or name.

```csharp
void CommandResetCounter(string id)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.CommandResetCounter("!hug");
```

## CommandResetAllUserCounters

Sets every viewer's use counter for a command back to 0, on all platforms. Stops your code with an error when no command has that id or name.

```csharp
void CommandResetAllUserCounters(string id)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.CommandResetAllUserCounters("!hug");
```

## CommandResetGlobalCooldown

Starts a command's cooldown for everyone again, with its full length. Stops your code with an error when no command has that id or name.

```csharp
void CommandResetGlobalCooldown(string id)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.CommandResetGlobalCooldown("!hug");
```

## CommandResetAllUserCooldowns

Starts every running per-viewer cooldown of a command again, with its full length. Stops your code with an error when no command has that id or name.

```csharp
void CommandResetAllUserCooldowns(string id)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.CommandResetAllUserCooldowns("!hug");
```

## CommandResetUserCooldown

Starts one viewer's cooldown for a command again, with its full length. Give their user id and platform; the shorter forms mean Twitch.

```csharp
void CommandResetUserCooldown(string id, string userId, Platform platform)
void CommandResetUserCooldown(string id, string userId)
void CommandResetUserCooldown(string id, int userId)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.CommandResetUserCooldown("!hug", "12345678", Platform.Twitch);
```

## CommandRemoveGlobalCooldown

Ends a command's cooldown for everyone right now, so it can be used again. Stops your code with an error when no command has that id or name.

```csharp
void CommandRemoveGlobalCooldown(string id)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.CommandRemoveGlobalCooldown("!hug");
```

## CommandRemoveAllUserCooldowns

Ends every per-viewer cooldown of a command right now. The cooldown for everyone keeps running. Stops your code with an error when no command has that id or name.

```csharp
void CommandRemoveAllUserCooldowns(string id)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.CommandRemoveAllUserCooldowns("!hug");
```

## CommandRemoveUserCooldown

Ends one viewer's cooldown for a command right now. Give their user id and platform; the shorter forms mean Twitch.

```csharp
void CommandRemoveUserCooldown(string id, string userId, Platform platform)
void CommandRemoveUserCooldown(string id, string userId)
void CommandRemoveUserCooldown(string id, int userId)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.CommandRemoveUserCooldown("!hug", "12345678", Platform.Twitch);
```

## CommandAddToGlobalCooldown

Adds seconds to a command's cooldown for everyone. If it is not running, it starts now with that many seconds. Stops your code with an error when no command has that id or name.

```csharp
void CommandAddToGlobalCooldown(string id, int seconds)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.CommandAddToGlobalCooldown("!hug", 30);
```

## CommandAddToAllUserCooldowns

Adds seconds to every running per-viewer cooldown of a command. Viewers without a running cooldown are not changed. Stops your code with an error when no command has that id or name.

```csharp
void CommandAddToAllUserCooldowns(string id, int seconds)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.CommandAddToAllUserCooldowns("!hug", 30);
```

## CommandAddToUserCooldown

Adds seconds to one viewer's cooldown for a command (starting it when it is not running). Give their user id and platform; the shorter forms mean Twitch.

```csharp
void CommandAddToUserCooldown(string id, string userId, Platform platform, int seconds)
void CommandAddToUserCooldown(string id, string userId, int seconds)
void CommandAddToUserCooldown(string id, int userId, int seconds)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.CommandAddToUserCooldown("!hug", "12345678", Platform.Twitch, 30);
```

## CommandGetUserCounter

Tells you how many times one viewer used a command, by their login name, platform and the command's id or name.

```csharp
CommandCounter? CommandGetUserCounter(string userLogin, Platform platform, string commandId)
```

**Gives back:** The viewer's counter (with Count), or null (nothing) when the command does not exist.

**Example**

```csharp
var counter = CPH.CommandGetUserCounter("coolviewer", Platform.Twitch, "!hug");
if (counter != null) CPH.LogInfo($"{counter.UserName} used it {counter.Count} times.");
```

## CommandGetUserCounterById

Tells you how many times one viewer used a command, by their user id, platform and the command's id or name.

```csharp
CommandCounter? CommandGetUserCounterById(string userId, Platform platform, string commandId)
```

**Gives back:** The viewer's counter (with Count), or null (nothing) when the command does not exist.

**Example**

```csharp
var counter = CPH.CommandGetUserCounterById("12345678", Platform.Twitch, "!hug");
if (counter != null) CPH.LogInfo($"Used {counter.Count} times.");
```

## CommandResetUserCounter

Sets one viewer's use counter for a command back to 0, by their user id and platform. Stops your code with an error when no command has that id or name.

```csharp
void CommandResetUserCounter(string commandId, string userId, Platform platform)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.CommandResetUserCounter("!hug", "12345678", Platform.Twitch);
```

## CommandResetUsersCounters

Sets every viewer's use counter for a command back to 0, for one platform only. Cuebot always saves counters, so the true/false value is ignored.

```csharp
void CommandResetUsersCounters(string commandId, Platform platform, bool persisted)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.CommandResetUsersCounters("!hug", Platform.Twitch, true);
```

## CommandSetGlobalCooldownDuration

Changes how long a command's cooldown for everyone lasts, in seconds, and saves it. Below 0 counts as 0. Stops your code with an error when no command has that id or name.

```csharp
void CommandSetGlobalCooldownDuration(string id, int seconds)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.CommandSetGlobalCooldownDuration("!hug", 60);
```

## CommandSetUserCooldownDuration

Changes how long a command's per-viewer cooldown lasts, in seconds, and saves it. Below 0 counts as 0. Stops your code with an error when no command has that id or name.

```csharp
void CommandSetUserCooldownDuration(string id, int seconds)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.CommandSetUserCooldownDuration("!hug", 120);
```

## AddGroup

Makes a new, empty group of viewers.

```csharp
bool AddGroup(string groupName)
```

**Gives back:** true when it was made. false when the name is empty or already used.

**Example**

```csharp
bool made = CPH.AddGroup("Regulars");
CPH.LogInfo($"Group made: {made}");
```

## DeleteGroup

Deletes a group of viewers.

```csharp
bool DeleteGroup(string groupName)
```

**Gives back:** true when it was deleted. false when there is no such group.

**Example**

```csharp
bool deleted = CPH.DeleteGroup("Regulars");
CPH.LogInfo($"Deleted: {deleted}");
```

## GetGroups

Gives you the names of all your viewer groups.

```csharp
List<string> GetGroups()
```

**Gives back:** A list of group names.

**Example**

```csharp
var groups = CPH.GetGroups();
CPH.LogInfo(string.Join(", ", groups));
```

## GroupExists

Checks whether you have a viewer group with this name.

```csharp
bool GroupExists(string groupName)
```

**Gives back:** true when the group exists, otherwise false.

**Example**

```csharp
bool exists = CPH.GroupExists("Regulars");
CPH.LogInfo($"Regulars exists: {exists}");
```

## ClearUsersFromGroup

Takes every viewer out of a group. The group itself stays.

```csharp
bool ClearUsersFromGroup(string groupName)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked. false when there is no such group.

**Example**

```csharp
bool cleared = CPH.ClearUsersFromGroup("Regulars");
CPH.LogInfo($"Cleared: {cleared}");
```

## UsersInGroup

Gives you a list of the viewers in a group, each with their id, login, name and platform.

```csharp
List<GroupUser> UsersInGroup(string groupName)
```

**Gives back:** A list of viewers (empty when the group does not exist).

**Example**

```csharp
var users = CPH.UsersInGroup("Regulars");
CPH.LogInfo($"{users.Count} people in Regulars.");
```

## AddUserToGroup

Adds a viewer to a group, by their name and platform. The form without a platform means Twitch. The group must already exist.

```csharp
bool AddUserToGroup(string userName, Platform platform, string groupName)
bool AddUserToGroup(string userName, string groupName)
```

**Gives back:** true when they were added. false when they were already in it or the group does not exist.

**Example**

```csharp
bool added = CPH.AddUserToGroup("coolviewer", Platform.Twitch, "Regulars");
CPH.LogInfo($"Added: {added}");
```

## AddUserIdToGroup

Adds a viewer to a group, by their user id and platform. The form without a platform means Twitch. The group must already exist.

```csharp
bool AddUserIdToGroup(string userId, Platform platform, string groupName)
bool AddUserIdToGroup(string userId, string groupName)
```

**Gives back:** true when they were added. false when they were already in it or the group does not exist.

**Example**

```csharp
bool added = CPH.AddUserIdToGroup("12345678", Platform.Twitch, "Regulars");
CPH.LogInfo($"Added: {added}");
```

## RemoveUserFromGroup

Takes a viewer out of a group, by their name and platform. The form without a platform means Twitch.

```csharp
bool RemoveUserFromGroup(string userName, Platform platform, string groupName)
bool RemoveUserFromGroup(string userName, string groupName)
```

**Gives back:** true when they were removed. false when they were not in it.

**Example**

```csharp
bool removed = CPH.RemoveUserFromGroup("coolviewer", Platform.Twitch, "Regulars");
CPH.LogInfo($"Removed: {removed}");
```

## RemoveUserIdFromGroup

Takes a viewer out of a group, by their user id and platform. The form without a platform means Twitch.

```csharp
bool RemoveUserIdFromGroup(string userId, Platform platform, string groupName)
bool RemoveUserIdFromGroup(string userId, string groupName)
```

**Gives back:** true when they were removed. false when they were not in it.

**Example**

```csharp
bool removed = CPH.RemoveUserIdFromGroup("12345678", Platform.Twitch, "Regulars");
CPH.LogInfo($"Removed: {removed}");
```

## UserInGroup

Checks whether a viewer is in a group, by their name and platform. The form without a platform means Twitch.

```csharp
bool UserInGroup(string userName, Platform platform, string groupName)
bool UserInGroup(string userName, string groupName)
```

**Gives back:** true when they are in the group, otherwise false.

**Example**

```csharp
bool inGroup = CPH.UserInGroup("coolviewer", Platform.Twitch, "Regulars");
CPH.LogInfo($"In group: {inGroup}");
```

## UserIdInGroup

Checks whether a viewer is in a group, by their user id and platform. The form without a platform means Twitch.

```csharp
bool UserIdInGroup(string userId, Platform platform, string groupName)
bool UserIdInGroup(string userId, string groupName)
```

**Gives back:** true when they are in the group, otherwise false.

**Example**

```csharp
bool inGroup = CPH.UserIdInGroup("12345678", Platform.Twitch, "Regulars");
CPH.LogInfo($"In group: {inGroup}");
```

## EnableTimer

Turns a timer on, by its name (an id works too), and starts its countdown from now. Lasts until the timer is edited or Cuebot restarts. Errors when there is no such timer.

```csharp
void EnableTimer(string timerName)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.EnableTimer("Hydrate Reminder");
```

## DisableTimer

Turns a timer off, by its name (an id works too). Lasts until the timer is edited or Cuebot restarts. Stops your code with an error when there is no such timer.

```csharp
void DisableTimer(string timerName)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.DisableTimer("Hydrate Reminder");
```

## EnableTimerById

Turns a timer on, by its id (a name works too), and starts its countdown from now. Lasts until the timer is edited or Cuebot restarts. Errors when there is no such timer.

```csharp
void EnableTimerById(string timerId)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.EnableTimerById("5f2c1a7e-3b4d-4e8f-9a10-2b3c4d5e6f70");
```

## DisableTimerById

Turns a timer off, by its id (a name works too). Lasts until the timer is edited or Cuebot restarts. Stops your code with an error when there is no such timer.

```csharp
void DisableTimerById(string timerId)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.DisableTimerById("5f2c1a7e-3b4d-4e8f-9a10-2b3c4d5e6f70");
```

## GetTimerState

Checks whether a timer is on right now, by its id or name. Stops your code with an error when there is no such timer.

```csharp
bool GetTimerState(string timerId)
```

**Gives back:** true when the timer is on, otherwise false.

**Example**

```csharp
bool on = CPH.GetTimerState("Hydrate Reminder");
CPH.LogInfo($"Timer on: {on}");
```

## SetTimerInterval

Changes how often a timer fires, in seconds, and starts its countdown again. Lasts until the timer is edited or Cuebot restarts. Errors when there is no such timer.

```csharp
void SetTimerInterval(string timerId, int interval)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.SetTimerInterval("Hydrate Reminder", 900);
```

## RegisterCustomTrigger

Adds a choice to the "Custom code event" trigger, so you can pick the event name from a list. Usually called from Init(). Categories are optional.

```csharp
bool RegisterCustomTrigger(string triggerName, string eventName, string[]? categories = null)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked. false when the event name is empty.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.RegisterCustomTrigger("Confetti blast", "confetti", new[] { "Fun" });
CPH.LogInfo($"Registered: {ok}");
```

## TriggerCodeEvent

Fires a custom event by name. Actions with a "Custom code event" trigger for it run. They get this action's variables (pass false to skip), or the values you hand over.

```csharp
void TriggerCodeEvent(string eventName, bool useArgs = true)
void TriggerCodeEvent(string eventName, Dictionary<string, object?> args)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.TriggerCodeEvent("confetti");
CPH.TriggerCodeEvent("confetti", new Dictionary<string, object> { ["amount"] = 50 });
```

## WebsocketBroadcastJson

Sends JSON data to every program connected to Cuebot's WebSocket server (Streamer.bot API), as a General.Custom event. Text that is not valid JSON is sent as plain text.

```csharp
void WebsocketBroadcastJson(string data)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.WebsocketBroadcastJson("{\"scene\": \"Gameplay\"}");
```

## WebsocketBroadcastString

Sends text to every program connected to Cuebot's WebSocket server (Streamer.bot API), as a General.Custom event.

```csharp
void WebsocketBroadcastString(string data)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.WebsocketBroadcastString("Round over!");
```

## WebsocketConnect

Connects one of your WebSocket clients (set up on the Servers page). 0 is your first client. Errors when there is no such client.

```csharp
void WebsocketConnect(int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.WebsocketConnect(0);
```

## WebsocketDisconnect

Disconnects one of your WebSocket clients (set up on the Servers page). 0 is your first client.

```csharp
void WebsocketDisconnect(int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.WebsocketDisconnect(0);
```

## WebsocketIsConnected

Checks whether one of your WebSocket clients is connected. 0 is your first client.

```csharp
bool WebsocketIsConnected(int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** true while it is connected, otherwise false.

**Example**

```csharp
bool connected = CPH.WebsocketIsConnected(0);
CPH.LogInfo($"Client connected: {connected}");
```

## WebsocketSend

Sends text through one of your WebSocket clients (set up on the Servers page). 0 is your first client.

```csharp
void WebsocketSend(string data, int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.WebsocketSend("{\"cmd\": \"flash\"}", 0);
```

## WebsocketGetConnectionByName

Finds the number of one of your WebSocket clients by its name, to use with the other Websocket methods.

```csharp
int WebsocketGetConnectionByName(string name)
```

**Gives back:** The client's number (0 is the first), or -1 when no client has that name.

**Example**

```csharp
int client = CPH.WebsocketGetConnectionByName("Lights");
CPH.LogInfo($"Lights is client {client}");
```

## WebsocketCustomServerStart

Starts one of your custom WebSocket servers (set up on the Servers page). 0 is your first server. Nothing changes if it is already running.

```csharp
void WebsocketCustomServerStart(int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.WebsocketCustomServerStart(0);
```

## WebsocketCustomServerStop

Stops one of your custom WebSocket servers. 0 is your first server.

```csharp
void WebsocketCustomServerStop(int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.WebsocketCustomServerStop(0);
```

## WebsocketCustomServerIsListening

Checks whether one of your custom WebSocket servers is running. 0 is your first server.

```csharp
bool WebsocketCustomServerIsListening(int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** true while it is running, otherwise false.

**Example**

```csharp
bool running = CPH.WebsocketCustomServerIsListening(0);
CPH.LogInfo($"Server running: {running}");
```

## WebsocketCustomServerBroadcast

Sends text to everyone connected to one of your custom WebSocket servers, or to only one connection when you give its session id. 0 is your first server.

```csharp
void WebsocketCustomServerBroadcast(string data, string? sessionId = null, int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.WebsocketCustomServerBroadcast("Round over!", null, 0);
```

## WebsocketCustomServerCloseSession

Closes one connection (session) on one of your custom WebSocket servers, by its session id.

```csharp
void WebsocketCustomServerCloseSession(string sessionId, int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.WebsocketCustomServerCloseSession("a1b2c3", 0);
```

## WebsocketCustomServerCloseAllSessions

Closes every connection on one of your custom WebSocket servers. The server keeps running.

```csharp
void WebsocketCustomServerCloseAllSessions(int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.WebsocketCustomServerCloseAllSessions(0);
```

## WebsocketCustomServerGetConnectionByName

Finds the number of one of your custom WebSocket servers by its name, to use with the other WebsocketCustomServer methods.

```csharp
int WebsocketCustomServerGetConnectionByName(string name)
```

**Gives back:** The server's number (0 is the first), or -1 when no server has that name.

**Example**

```csharp
int server = CPH.WebsocketCustomServerGetConnectionByName("Overlay");
CPH.LogInfo($"Overlay is server {server}");
```
